abilities.name: Type Atk Buff - Num. of Moves
abilities.page: Type Atk Buff - Num. of Moves
lines: Type attack of all party members +20% \ +30% \ +40% \ +50% \ +60% \ +65% \ +70% (1 move)
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 \ 5 \ 6 \ 7 ) of moves in a turn.
** Multihit single move skills, all turn-end attacks of same character are counted as +1 move
** Multi-move skills like Copy are counted as +2 moves.
** Each counter with attack is counted as +1 move
** Moves of dead allies are not counted.
